description: In the heart of Le Marais, located on the first floor of an old Parisian building, you will feel at home in this chic apartment with 5 private bedrooms, a cozy living room and a self-service kitchen, with all the services of a boutique hotel. Breakfast available as an option on demand.Before your arrival you will receive your personal codes to access the property and your room in full autonomy.Every room is decorated differently, has a private bathroom, heating/AC , TV and amenitiesThe spaceTo ensure a comfortable stay, housekeeping is provided every day before 1 p.m. with towels, sheets and toiletries.Upon request before your arriva , a daily continental breakfast can be organised between 7:30 am and 10 am in our cosy and comfortable lounge.SPECIAL NOTE COVID-19:Small changes in our operations are likely to be made during the entire period of the Corona virus pandemic.Gel and masks will be made available in each room. The cleaning procedures will be reinforced and the rooms will be disinfected after the departure of the travelers.Guest accessThe entire apartement, that is normally run as a Deluxe B&B, will be privatised for you. Guests will have access to the common areas : reception and lounge , shared kitchen, and of course private access to their room.Other things to noteThere is no washing machine on-site, but there is an automated laundry 5 minutes walking distance from where we are.
